notes: The first public release, for macOS 13 or later on Apple silicon.
changes: The launcher: every app's engine runs in its own small virtual machine and its window in a sandbox on your Mac, and you choose which folders and which websites each app may reach.
Fourteen sample apps come with the launcher: Load examples installs the ones you pick, and nothing is allowed until you say so.
The Inspector shows every message between an app's window and its engine, and every internet connection an app tries, live.
The launcher tells you when a newer version is available and can update itself.
Browse an app registry, install an app from it, and publish your own app from the launcher.
Apps can ask to see your screen, use the mouse and keyboard, run tools you registered, use the microphone, or use your Mac's GPU.
